# ADR-3113: A10: File URL scheme open for import job 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

file:// URLs read local secrets.

## Decision

Importers SHALL NOT allow a file URL scheme open for import job 5 (A10-5).

## Consequences

Only https schemes are is expected to.
